translations.1: And this is the thing which you shall do for them, to consecrate them that they may serve as imāms for Me: take a young bull from the cattle, and two rams without blemish;
translations.2: and unleavened bread, and unleavened loaves kneaded with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil — from fine wheat flour you shall make them;
translations.3: and place them in one basket, and present them in it, together with the young bull and the two rams.
translations.4: Then bring Aaron and his sons forward to the entrance of the tent of the appointed gathering, and wash them with water.
translations.5: And take the garments, and clothe Aaron with the tunic, and the robe, and the breastpiece, and the ephod, and fasten him with its binding-straps.
translations.6: And set the turban upon his head, and place the crown of holiness beneath the turban.
translations.7: And take from the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
translations.8: Then bring his sons forward, and clothe them with tunics.
translations.9: And bind them with sashes — Aaron and his sons — and put headwear upon them; and the imāmate shall be theirs as an ordinance forever. And complete the required duty of Aaron and the required duty of his sons.
translations.10: And bring the young bull forward before the tent of the appointed gathering, and Aaron and his sons shall lean their hands upon its head.
translations.11: And slaughter it before God, at the entrance of the tent of the appointed gathering.
translations.12: And take from its blood, and place it upon the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour the remainder of it at the base of the altar.
translations.13: And take from it the fat-membrane covering the belly, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys with the fat that is upon them, and burn these upon the altar.
translations.14: But the flesh of the young bull, and its hide, and its dung — burn with fire outside the camp, for it is a purification-offering.
translations.15: Then bring forward one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lean their hands upon its head.
translations.16: And slaughter it, and take from its blood, and sprinkle it upon the altar all around.
translations.17: And cut it into its members, and wash its belly and its shanks, and add them upon the altar.
translations.18: For it is an ascending-offering to God — accepted and pleasing; it is an offering to God.
translations.19: And bring forward the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lean their hands upon its head.
translations.20: And slaughter it, and take from its blood and place it upon the cartilage of the earlobe of Aaron, and upon the cartilages of the earlobes of his sons on the right side, and upon the thumbs of their right hands; and sprinkle the remainder of the blood upon the altar all around.
translations.21: And take from the blood that is upon the altar and from the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon the altar and upon Aaron and his garments, and upon his sons and the garments of his sons with him — so that he and his garments shall be consecrated, and his sons and the garments of his sons with him.
translations.22: And take from the ram the fat and the fat-tail, and all the fat-membrane covering the belly, and the appendage of the liver and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shank — for it is the ram of completion.
translations.23: And from each kind — one loaf of bread, and one thick loaf with oil, and one spread wafer — from the basket of unleavened bread that is before God.
translations.24: And place all of it upon the palms of Aaron and the palms of his sons, and wave it in a waving motion before God.
translations.25: Then take it from their hands, and burn it upon the altar together with the ascending-offering — accepted and pleasing before God; it is an offering to God.
translations.26: And take the breast from the ram of completion that belongs to Aaron, and wave it in a waving motion before God, and it shall be a portion for you.
translations.27: And consecrate the breast of the waving and the shank of the elevation — that which was waved and that which was raised — from the ram of completion that belongs to Aaron and to his sons.
translations.28: And it shall be for Aaron and for his sons an ordinance forever from the sons of Israel; for they are an elevation — so shall they be an elevation from the sons of Israel from their peace-offerings; they are their elevation to God.
translations.29: And the holy garments that belong to Aaron shall be for his sons after him, that they may be anointed in them and that their required duty may be completed by them.
translations.30: Seven days shall the imām who comes after him from his sons wear them, when he enters the tent of the appointed gathering to serve in the holy place.
translations.31: And take the ram of completion, and cook its flesh in a consecrated place.
translations.32: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, together with the bread that is in the basket, at the entrance of the tent of the appointed meeting.
translations.33: And those for whom atonement was made with them shall eat them, to complete their required duty and to consecrate them; but a stranger shall not eat, for they are holy.
translations.34: And if any of the flesh of the completion-offering or of the bread remains until the morning, it shall be burned with fire — it shall not be eaten, for it is holy.
translations.35: And do thus for Aaron and his sons — according to all that I have commanded you; seven days you shall complete their required duty.
translations.36: And a young bull of the purification-offering you shall make each day for atonement; and thereby purify the altar, and seek atonement at it, and anoint it and consecrate it.
translations.37: Seven days you shall seek atonement at it and consecrate it; and the altar shall become of the especial class of the most holy things — whoever approaches anything of it shall be consecrated.
translations.38: And this is what you shall offer upon the altar: two yearling lambs, each day, continually.
translations.39: One of them in the morning, and the other between the two sunsets.
translations.40: And a tenth-measure of fine flour kneaded with a quarter of a qisṭ of pressed olive oil, and a libation of a quarter of a qisṭ of wine — with each lamb.
translations.41: And when you offer the second between the two sunsets, as the gift-offering of the morning and its libation you shall make it — accepted and pleasing; an offering to God.
translations.42: A perpetual ascending-offering for your generations, at the entrance of the tent of the appointed gathering before God — where I shall be present for you there, and shall address you there.
translations.43: And when I am present there for the sons of Israel, the house shall be consecrated by My light.
translations.44: And I shall consecrate by it the tent of the appointed gathering and the altar, and I shall consecrate Aaron and his sons that they may serve as imāms for Me.
translations.45: And I shall make My light dwell among the sons of Israel, and I shall be their God.
translations.46: And they shall know that I am God their Lord, who brought them out from the land of Egypt, that I might make My light dwell among them. I am God their Lord — I shall fulfil this.
